en.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Dominates Opening Day, Nears Franchise Record
en.summary: Sony's new take on the zombie classic, directed by Zach Cregger, has stormed the box office, raking in an impressive $26.3 million on its opening day. This strong debut positions the film for a potential franchise record-breaking weekend.
en.body:
The autumn chill might be settling in, but moviegoers are clearly eager for a dose of adrenaline and scares, and **Zach Cregger**'s new **Resident Evil** has delivered in a big way. On its opening day, the film clawed its way to a formidable $26.3 million domestically across 3,684 screens. This figure not only makes it the undisputed No. 1 new release of the weekend but also sets the stage for what could be a monumental opening for the entire **Resident Evil** cinematic universe.

This impressive debut is a testament to Cregger's burgeoning directorial talent. Fresh off the phenomenal success of his original film **Weapons**, which grossed $270 million worldwide against a $40 million budget, Cregger has demonstrated a remarkable ability to turn original concepts into box office gold. Now, he's tasked with revitalizing an established IP that, while beloved, has seen fluctuating financial fortunes. If these opening day numbers are any indication, Cregger might just be the filmmaker to recapture the magic and set new benchmarks for the franchise.

The film's early success is particularly noteworthy given its official R rating, which promises "intense bloody violence, gore, and explicit language." This commitment to the horror roots of the **Resident Evil** brand, combined with Cregger's proven track record, seems to be resonating strongly with audiences who are hungry for visceral, high-stakes horror experiences.

## A Franchise Reborn?

The stakes for this new **Resident Evil** were high, aiming to surpass previous franchise bests. The current record holder for an opening weekend is **Resident Evil: Afterlife**, which debuted with $26.6 million. Cregger's film has already surpassed the opening day performance of his own previous hit, **Weapons**, which opened with $43.5 million over its entire debut weekend. With its $26.3 million opening day haul, the new **Resident Evil** is not just on track to break franchise records, but it's already setting a new standard for what fans can expect from this long-running series.

## Fan Anticipation and What's Next

Fans have been eagerly anticipating Cregger's take on **Resident Evil**, especially after the critical and commercial success of **Weapons**. The promise of a return to the franchise's horror roots, coupled with a director known for delivering original, thrilling cinematic experiences, has clearly generated significant buzz. The film's strong opening day performance suggests that this anticipation has translated directly into ticket sales, with many eager to see if the film can maintain its momentum throughout the weekend and beyond.

**Resident Evil** officially premiered in theaters on September 18, 2026. All eyes are now on the weekend box office totals to see if it will indeed achieve record-breaking status for the franchise, solidifying Zach Cregger's position as a master of both original horror and beloved IP reinvention.
